title: Sets of flags with no common opposite in finite projective planes
description:
Every finite projective plane of order s at least three admits s+1 incident flags with no common opposite and with noncollinear point entries and nonconcurrent line entries. For prime powers q at least three in PG(2,q), the construction gives all such sets, and there are q³(q+1)(q²+q+1) unordered sets.

The classification uses the classical Blokhuis–Wilbrink nucleus bound. Classification in arbitrary non-Desarguesian planes remains outside this result.

Includes the manuscript, LaTeX and bibliography, proof guides, audit summaries, exact replay, and interactive illustration. Internally reviewed. External peer review is pending.
